newsitem.title: USA: Collins & Aikman says will sell unit.
newsitem.headline: Collins & Aikman says will sell unit.

text.p: Collins & Aikman Corp said Friday it has entered into a definitive agreement to sell its Mastercraft Group unit to the privately-held Joan Fabrics Corp for $310 million.

The company said the deal, which is subject to financing, adjustments and other conditions, includes the assumption of specified liabilities. The company was not immediately able to specify what these liablities are.
The company said the deal is expected to close in about 60 to 90 days.
The company said it will use the proceeds of the sale to reduce long-term debt.
Collins & Aikman is an automotive interior systems supplier.
